a.title: Standard Agent
a.description: This extension describes a natural or legal person. The extension can be used to model contacts. Furthermore, the extension can be used in conditions to model executors.
a.$comment: If this extension is used in destroyConditions, the DCA must know who is its user.

name.name: string
name.description: This is a human readable name of the natural or legal person.

mbox.description: This is the email address where the person to contact can be reached.

homepage.description: Sometimes contacts have their own website as a first point of contact. The website can be added here.

img.description: For some DCA it makes sense to display a picture as well. The image can be stored here as a hyperreference or base64 string.
